goal: Allow importdescriptors to skip blockchain rescans entirely by supporting a "never" timestamp option
Avoid unnecessary rescan latency when importing descriptors known to be new or when deferring rescans
reviewability: Needs rebase against master, but the logic can be reviewed now
agreement: General support for adding "never" to skip rescans (mprenditore, davidrobinsonau, rkrux)
Verified that "never" skips rescanning while "now" rescans (davidrobinsonau)
Unaddressed objection: negative timestamp validation belongs in a separate commit (furszy)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it eliminates the mandatory two-hour rescan window imposed when using "now" for fresh descriptors
Provides a quality-of-life speedup for users importing descriptors without history
